text:
maya: Quick flag — we started seeing a cluster of structured fncall rejects this morning that the console shows as 'schema mismatch' but the sample payloads look fine. shipping app hit errors in prod.

maya: Example from traces: 
```
{"request_id":"r-9ab3","route":"/generate","model_variant":"redwood-degen-v1","fncall":{"name":"get_invoice","args":{"id":12345}}}
```
Console: validation error: expected object for `result` but got null.

dan: Do we have the raw agent response for that request id? The logs should show the model output before validation.

maya: yes attached in traces, it's a short freeform text that our validator coerced to null during parse. I think something in adapter coercion changed.

ciara: Noticed around the same minute there was an arbitration policy tweak to prefer cheaper variants under quota pressure. Could be a routing -> variant mismatch producing unexpected shape.

paul: If a request gets routed to degen variant, the model sometimes returns plain text instead of structured JSON. We have a shim that coerces but it can return null for malformed shapes.

maya: That matches. But why would console show schema mismatch counts for the main model route (not the degen route)? The route mapping in telemetry is showing them under the canonical route id.

ciara: We might be aggregating post-routing validation events before we attach route variant metadata. The console wants canonical route, but the validator fires *after* routing and loses variant info.

dan: Oof. So UX shows these errors as if the main variant failed validation, which is misleading for customers.

paul: Two problems: 1) routing policy recently reduced reserve capacity, causing more fallbacks to cheap variants. 2) validator telemetry doesn't include selected_variant tag when sampled.

maya: Can we quickly patch the telemetry to include variant_id in the validation event? That would make dashboards accurate and avoid wrong alerting.

ciara: Yes. I can add variant_id to the validation event envelope. Will take ~1 hour to instrument and push a small canary.

dan: Also let's change the console rollup to show both canonical route and actual variant counts. The UI change can be follow-up. For now, adding variant_id to events will fix most confusion.

ops-bot: [ALERT] Routing policy update deployed by @ops at 2026-03-19T09:12:04Z: arbitration.threshold lowered to 0.65.

maya: That ops-bot timestamp lines up with spike start. Good catch.

paul: One more thing — sampling rate for validation telemetry is 0.01 by default. We should temporarily increase sampling for any route that spikes to 1% -> 10% to get enough trace coverage.

ciara: Agree. I'll add a temporary override for the next 4 hours for that route.

dan: Who owns the customer-facing alert? Right now the alert fired and paged core infra. It should instead page eng-platform on schema spike for structured outputs.

maya: I'll take ownership of the alert routing update. Will update alert playbook to check variant tag once telemetry is shipped.

ciara: Plan: (1) instrument variant_id in validation events (ciara, 1h) (2) bump sampling for route (ciara, 10m) (3) patch alert routing to eng-platform (maya, 30m) (4) console rollup change (dan/paul, next sprint).

paul: Small mitigation: when validator sees a plain-text model reply for a fncall, emit a degen_fallback metric so we can graph and correlate with quota/route changes. I'll add that in the validator shim now.

maya: Thanks. If anyone reproduces a concrete example, drop the request_id here and I'll attach it to the customer incident.

dan: I'll follow up with a quick postmortem note once telemetry changes are live.

ops-bot: [INFO] Canary deploy success: telemetry-service v3.22.1 (ciara) at 2026-03-19T10:05:23Z.

ciara: Telemetry patch live to canary and variant_id is present in validation events. Increasing sampling on route r-invoice-generate to 10%.

maya: Seeing validation events with variant_id now. Spike still present but counts attribute to degen variant. Great.

paul: Deployed the degen_fallback metric. Early graphs show 82% of these rejects are from the cheaper variant.

maya: Closing loop: I'll update customer alert to reference degen fallback metric and route alerts to eng-platform. Thanks all. :tada:

ciara: I'll file the console UX ticket for rollup changes and link it here.

dan: Nice quick triage team.
